description: Product-independent mobile/off-grid abstract architecture generation; nominal DC/PV/AC domains and explicit directed functional paths, without installation approval or product matching.
rationale: 12/24/48 V are project-supported exploration families, not preferences, vehicle defaults or standards values. At most 16 distinct voltage choices and two AC arrangements yield 32 candidates; fixed voltage is one choice. Compatible complete load domains share one functional boundary without inventing simultaneity, aggregate capacity or per-load product slots. Explicit isolation and unknown compatibility retain separate boundaries. This is one deterministic partition, not a Cartesian search dimension. 64 loads and 16 charging sources bound linear topology/trace work per candidate; conservative operating limits without measured production evidence. Reconsider with a supported larger requirements corpus. Bounds narrow admission, never silently truncate generation.
